tickets.title: Create shared inheritance tracking ledger
tickets.text: Create a shared ledger for Nadia Thimblefern to track inherited accounts, estate contacts, forms received, ownership notes, and open questions.
tickets.evidence: Nadia asked for a shared tracking ledger for inherited accounts, estate contacts, forms received, ownership notes, and open questions so she can discuss the estate with Rowan using the same record set; they agreed to build it by 2024-02-23.

tickets.title: Upload certified authority paperwork to portal
tickets.text: Upload the certified authority documents provided by Galen Nettlewhisk to the secure portal for the custodian and Teacup Comet Bank.
tickets.evidence: the certified authority paperwork needed by the custodian and bank has not been uploaded to the secure portal; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-02-20.

tickets.title: Resolve estate bank access issue
tickets.text: Work with Teacup Comet Bank to correct the executor record mismatch preventing Nadia Thimblefern from accessing the estate account.
tickets.evidence: Teacup Comet Bank rejected Nadia’s online estate-account access attempt and told her the executor record did not match its internal file, preventing her from viewing recent estate cash activity; the agreed follow-up on the estate bank access problem is due 2024-02-16.

tickets.title: Confirm IRA beneficiary designation for inherited account
tickets.text: Confirm the correct beneficiary percentage for Alden’s IRA by reconciling Nadia Thimblefern’s paper copy with the custodian portal before signing paperwork.
tickets.evidence: For Alden’s IRA beneficiary percentage, Nadia brought a paper beneficiary copy that does not match the percentage shown in the custodian portal, and the controlling designation needs to be confirmed before inherited IRA paperwork is signed; follow-up is needed, with no date supplied.

tickets.title: Organize estate inventory for CPA and attorney
tickets.text: Prepare a consolidated summary of the estate inventory, anticipated income items, and beneficiary distributions for Iris Dewspindle and Galen Nettlewhisk by the tax‑planning deadline.
tickets.evidence: The estate inventory, anticipated income items, and beneficiary distributions need to be organized for the CPA and estate attorney before the next tax-planning conversation tied to the estate administration calendar;

tickets.title: Update fiduciary role in personal estate documents
tickets.text: Revise the 2016 personal estate documents to remove Alden Thimblefern’s successor fiduciary role and reflect the current executor arrangement for Nadia Thimblefern.
tickets.evidence: The planning review found the 2016 personal estate documents’ reference to Alden in a successor fiduciary role creates a stale appointment after his death;

tickets.title: Develop separate investment framework for inherited assets
tickets.text: Design a distinct investment and spending framework for Nadia Thimblefern’s inherited assets that supports retirement flexibility, college costs, cash reserves, and avoids blending with routine household spending.
tickets.evidence: Nadia wants a separate investment and spending framework for inherited assets that accounts for retirement flexibility, college costs, cash reserves, and her preference not to blend estate proceeds into routine spending immediately; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-03-15.
